column1: CME FedWatch per-meeting panels  captured 2026-09-23 probabilities in percent. A second independent capture from the conditional-probability grid in 2026-09-22_probabilities.csv. The two disagree slightly (54.2% vs 55.4% hike at the October meeting) because the market moved between them; each is internally consistent  so both are usable. ease/no_change/hike are cumulative against the target range prevailing at capture (375-400): the chance the range at that meeting is below / equal to / above it. They are NOT the one-meeting transition probability -- the chance of a hike *at* a given meeting comes from the ratio of successive no_change values. mid_price is the contract price FedWatch shows next to each meeting. It tracks the prior session's settle to within a tick so this capture is paired with the 2026-09-21 settle strip rather than with prices of its own.
